context: Tests whether an agent correctly designs and implements custom OpenTelemetry metrics for a Node.js service, covering instrument type selection, UCUM units, naming conventions, cardinality management, and avoiding duplication of auto-instrumented metrics.

checklist.name: Histogram for durations
checklist.description: Uses a Histogram instrument (not Counter or Gauge) for measuring order/job processing time or any latency distribution

checklist.name: Counter for monotonic counts
checklist.description: Uses a Counter (not Gauge or UpDownCounter) for counting completed orders or processed items that only increase

checklist.name: UpDownCounter for queue depth
checklist.description: Uses an UpDownCounter (not Gauge or Counter) for tracking queue depth or any quantity that can both increase and decrease

checklist.name: UCUM units specified
checklist.description: Every metric creation call includes a unit using UCUM notation: 's' for seconds, '1' for dimensionless counts, 'By' for bytes

checklist.name: No unit in metric name
checklist.description: Metric names do NOT include the unit as a suffix (e.g., avoids names like '.seconds', '.milliseconds', '.bytes', '.ms')

checklist.name: No semconv namespace clash
checklist.description: Custom metric names do NOT start with reserved semconv namespace prefixes such as 'http.', 'db.', 'rpc.', 'messaging.', 'system.', 'process.' unless explicitly using the matching semconv metric

checklist.name: No high-cardinality metric attributes
checklist.description: Does NOT use unbounded identifiers (user.id, order.id, request.id, account.id, url.full, or ip.address) as metric attributes

checklist.name: Bounded attribute values only
checklist.description: Metric attributes use bounded-cardinality values: e.g., status bucketed by class ('success'/'error', or '2xx'/'4xx'/'5xx'), not exact codes or IDs

checklist.name: No duplicate auto-instrumented metric
checklist.description: Does NOT manually recreate a metric already emitted by auto-instrumentation (e.g., does not manually create 'http.server.request.duration' when @opentelemetry/instrumentation-http is already installed)

checklist.name: Metric shape test
checklist.description: Includes at least one integration test (or test stub) that asserts the expected shape of a custom metric: name, instrument type, unit, and attribute keys

checklist.name: Consistent units across instances
checklist.description: All metric creation calls for the same metric name use the same unit string (no mixing 's' and 'ms' for the same metric)

checklist.name: Metric name not an attribute key
checklist.description: No metric name is identical to a semantic convention attribute key (e.g., avoids naming a metric 'http.response.status_code')
